currentParagraphText: “I wouldn’t be,” Irin shook her head. “We are all fully aware of what’s happening and are all just taking advantage. Plus, even if the members of these factions have been told to try and get closer to us, that doesn’t mean genuine connections can’t be made. Everyone involved knows what’s happening, so no need to be concerned.”
